description: Starts a trade whose quote carries hyperliquid (it starts on Hyperliquid): give the quote's id and the sender's two signatures (eth_signTypedData_v4 of hyperliquid.authorize and of hyperliquid.transfer, each as it is). Both are checked against the quote's sender and handed on; nothing moves without them. Then follow the trade with get_trade_status(chainId, id). Works without an API key at a low shared rate.

authorizeSignature.description: The sender's signature of hyperliquid.authorize (0x, 65 bytes)

signature.description: The sender's signature of hyperliquid.transfer (0x, 65 bytes)

name: send_signatures
title: Start a trade from Hyperliquid
